title: Tan Pebbled Structured Tote Handbag
description: A structured tan tote in pebbled faux leather with twin rolled top handles. Gold-tone side rings let you add a strap for shoulder or crossbody wear, and the roomy shape holds everyday essentials.
seo_description: Structured tan pebbled faux leather tote with twin handles and gold-tone side rings for an optional strap.
